citation: Benitez-Cano A, Sancho-Araiz A, Carazo J, et al. Crit Care 2026;30:305
population: Critically ill adults, nosocomial pneumonia, surgical ICU Barcelona; RRT and ECMO were exclusion criteria
infusion_mode: Loading dose 2 g/0.5 g over 120 min, then 2 g/0.5 g q8h infused over 8 h (6 g/1.5 g per day)
anonymised_patient_id: PARTIAL - subject IDs 1-30 appear as panel headings in Supplementary Figures S3.3 and S3.4, but only as figure labels
concentration_observations: NO NUMERIC DATA. 74 plasma observations per analyte and 14 ELF observations per analyte are stated, but published only as median (IQR) at four nominal times
sampling_times: Design times only: end of loading dose, then 1, 4 and 8 h; ELF at 1, 4 or 8 h on days 3-4
dose_history: Protocol dose only; renal adjustment permitted on day 3 after sampling
plasma_conc: AGGREGATE ONLY - Supplementary Table S2 gives median (IQR) at each nominal time; AUC(0-8,ss) medians in the main text
elf_conc: AGGREGATE ONLY - ELF Css median (IQR) 45.2 [24.2] mg/L ceftazidime, 4.1 [3.4] mg/L avibactam
renal_function: AGGREGATE ONLY - CKD-EPI, arm median 63.0 mL/min/1.73 m2
age_sex: AGGREGATE ONLY - arm median 77 y; 1 of 15 female
rrt_ecmo_status: UNIFORMLY ABSENT BY DESIGN - both were exclusion criteria
mic_data: NO per-isolate MIC published; Vitek2 with EUCAST breakpoints; 6 of 15 culture-positive
isolate_info: Aggregate only; no DTR or carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales
blq_observations: NOT REPORTED - no censoring method stated anywhere
assay_error_lloq: YES - ceftazidime plasma LLOQ 2.5 mg/L (BAL 0.25-10); avibactam plasma LLOQ 0.1 mg/L (BAL 0.005-5); proportional residual error 0.27 and 0.32
clinical_outcomes: Aggregate only; not powered for clinical outcomes
model_code: NOT PROVIDED - no .mlxtran, no project file, no script
covariance_matrix: NO - RSE% only; no variance-covariance matrix, no CIs, no bootstrap
supplementary_individual_profiles: YES BUT GRAPHICAL ONLY - Supplementary Figures S3.3 and S3.4 give per-patient plasma and ELF panels headed by subject ID, on LOGARITHMIC axes with sparse gridlines; digitisation would carry material error and could not recover exact times or ELF sampling bin
public_repository: NONE - full-text and supplement searches for repository, github, zenodo, figshare returned nothing
data_availability_statement: PRESENT: 'The datasets used and analyzed during the current study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.'
corresponding_author_route: Luisa Sorli, lsorli@hmar.cat (printed in the affiliation footnotes)
classification: E (data potentially available by author request) / D (aggregate evidence only, as currently published)
evidence_and_url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13262505/ ; all three supplementary .docx files retrieved from static-content.springer.com and read in full. NOTE Supplementary Table S3.1 is titled 'Individual observed and predicted...' but every cell is a median (IQR) across patients - it is NOT individual data. THREE DIFFERENT ELF/plasma ratio pairs are published: median individual AUC ratios 0.41/0.44 (the pair this manuscript uses), model-based EPR 0.51/0.60, and S3.1 observed 0.46/0.40.
